message: @azure/monitor-opentelemetry: as of 1.20.1, known to depend on @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node ^2.10.0, which installs a second copy of the SDK.

@vercel/otel: as of 2.1.3, known to peer on @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base >=2.0.0 <3.0.0 and @opentelemetry/api-logs >=0.200.0 <0.300.0. It has to ship 3.0 support before this project can finish the move. npm install will fail with ERESOLVE until this is resolved.
